string.text: %c[255,96,160,255]Tactical Compass Hold%c[default]: Adds a hold keybind next to Tactical Compass's toggle. Compass flips on press and again on release. Bind under Tactical Compass -> Key binding.
Hold to invert the compass for as long as the key is down (peek if it is off, hide if it is on). Unbind to disable. Use a different key than the toggle.
